newsitem.title: CANADA: CBRS reaffirms Nova Scotia debt ratings.
newsitem.headline: CBRS reaffirms Nova Scotia debt ratings.

text.p: Canadian Bond Rating Service on Friday said it reaffirmed the long- and short-term debt ratings of the Province of Nova Scotia at A- and A-1 respectively.
The bond rating agency said the ratings outlook on both debt ratings remains negative.
In reaffirming the short term rating, CBRS said said Nova Scotia is the only province that sets no limit on its T-bill borrowing program, though the province has maintained a good maturity schedule.

In confirming the province's long term rating. The agency said that Nova Scotia remains saddled with significant levels of debt, even though the province has budgeted for surpluses over the next couple of years.
